description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class for the ViewImportvcard class within the SuiteCRM project. It defines unit tests to verify the constructor and display methods of the ViewImportvcard class, which is part of the MVC view component for importing vCards.

classes.name: ViewImportvcardTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ViewImportvcard view class, verifying object instantiation and display output.

methods.name: test__construct
methods.description: Tests that the ViewImportvcard constructor creates an object of the correct type with the expected 'type' attribute set to 'edit'.

methods.name: testdisplay
methods.description: Tests the display method of the ViewImportvcard class by assigning mock request parameters, invoking the method, and checking that it produces non-empty HTML content.
